diagnostic_finding_why_this_composition_.operator_session_gap: the only registered dashboard provider is dashboard_auth/basic (nous/self_hosted/drain disabled). Its credential exists only as HERMES_DASHBOARD_BASIC_AUTH_PASSWORD_HASH in .env. preflight_operator_metadata + _verify require a real Session proven by prove_operator(...), so Onboarding.prepare/activate cannot be executed without the owner's password. Minting a Session from the signing secret would bypass the password check and was rejected as a weaker contract.
